explanation: The category was new that year, and Shrek beat Pixar's Monsters, Inc. Spirited Away won it a year later, and Toy Story (1995) predates the award.
learnMore: Academy Award for Best Animated Feature

claims.text: Shrek won the first Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, at the 2002 ceremony.
Monsters, Inc. lost to Shrek in 2002, Spirited Away won the award a year later, and Toy Story (1995) came out before the award existed.
The Best Animated Feature award was first presented in 2002, for films released in 2001.
